opening.argument: The offering is presented as a cryptocurrency arbitrage bot delivering personal trading signals through Telegram. Its title advertises a Bitcoin arbitrage bot “sending signal via Telegram,” while the description offers a bot to monitor spreads across 12 exchanges and more than 77 digital assets. Viewers are also invited to receive personal arbitrage signals for free and directed to join a Telegram community. The displayed cryptocurrency chart, projected upward line, percentage alerts, and invitation for free custom alerts reinforce that this is a viewer-facing trading opportunity promoted through Telegram.
